policies.display_name: Storage accounts should disable public network access (ALZ-lite, mg-factory-corp)
policies.evidence_required: storage.bicep: AVM storage-account 0.33.1 param publicNetworkAccess: 'Disabled' (module default is null).
policies.rationale: WAF Security: blob reachable only through pe-blob; requirement 6 and baseline private PaaS.

policies.display_name: Public network access should be disabled for Container registries (ALZ-lite, mg-factory-corp)
policies.evidence_required: registry.bicep: AVM container-registry 0.13.1 param publicNetworkAccess: 'Disabled'; networkRuleBypassOptions: 'AzureServices' is the ADR-0004 network-rule exception, not public access.
policies.rationale: WAF Security: registry reachable only through pe-acr; trusted-services bypass limited to az acr import.

policies.display_name: Azure Key Vault should disable public network access (ALZ-lite, mg-factory-corp)
policies.evidence_required: keyvault.bicep: AVM key-vault 0.14.2 param publicNetworkAccess: 'Disabled' (module default is '').
policies.rationale: WAF Security: vault reachable only through pe-kv.

policies.display_name: Service Bus Namespaces should disable public network access (ALZ-lite, mg-factory-corp)
policies.evidence_required: messaging.bicep: AVM service-bus 0.17.1 param publicNetworkAccess: 'Disabled' (module falls back to Enabled without PE input) AND networkRuleSets: { publicNetworkAccess: 'Disabled', defaultAction: 'Deny', trustedServiceAccessEnabled: false } (Microsoft.ServiceBus/namespaces/networkRuleSets is evaluated by the same definition).
policies.rationale: WAF Security: namespace and its rule set reachable only through pe-sbns.

policies.display_name: Azure SQL Managed Instances should disable public network access (ALZ-lite, mg-factory-corp)
policies.evidence_required: sql-mi.bicep (raw @2025-01-01): publicDataEndpointEnabled: false.
policies.rationale: WAF Security: MI reachable only on its VNet-local host name.

policies.display_name: SFI-ID4.2.4 SQL Managed Instance - Safe Secrets Standard (Tenant Root Group)
policies.evidence_required: sql-mi.bicep: administrators { administratorType ActiveDirectory, principalType User, login/sid = deployer, azureADOnlyAuthentication: true }; no administratorLogin/password.
policies.rationale: WAF Security: Entra-only authentication, no SQL logins.

policies.display_name: Network interfaces should not have public IPs (ALZ-lite, mg-factory-corp)
policies.evidence_required: No public IP declared anywhere; PE NICs are platform-created without public IPs.
policies.rationale: WAF Security: no public IP on any workload NIC.

policies.display_name: Resources should not be created in West Europe (Tenant Root Group)
policies.evidence_required: main.bicep: param location @allowed(['swedencentral','germanywestcentral']); every resource uses location; preflight stops on any other hub region.
policies.rationale: WAF Reliability/Compliance: region pinned to approved EU regions.
